glosses: vara, a Portuguese rod, yard or ell, a former unit of length about equal to 1.1 m
square vara, a former unit of area about equal to 1.2 m²

examples.text: Eu comprei uma nova vara de pesca.
examples.en: I bought a new fishing rod.

examples.text: Pegue sua vara de pescar e a caixa de equipamento e vamos pescar.
examples.en: Grab your fishing pole and tackle box and let's go fishing.

examples.text: O Tom agarrou a vara de pescar da Mary para ajudá-la a puxar o peixe.
examples.en: Tom grabbed Mary's fishing pole to help her pull in the fish.
